text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no known antidote to idarubicin hydrochloride. Two cases of fatal overdosage in patients receiving therapy for AML have been reported. The doses were 135 mg/m 2 over 3 days and 45 mg/m 2 of idarubicin hydrochloride and 90 mg/m 2 of daunorubicin over a three-day period. Based on multicompartment and extravascular distribution, tissue binding, and low unbound fraction available in plasma, hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis are unlikely to significantly reduce exposure during an overdosage.
